Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the main change: NVTX rows are now included in tree search results. The changeset adds NVTX match counting to the shared search controls and excludes NVTX matches when resource type or FSM type filters are active. The title uses the fix: prefix and stays concise. It does not mention the type-filter exclusion, but that is a secondary aspect of the same fix.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description covers the purpose of the change, the related issue (Fixes `#924`), and the testing that was run, including the reasons the full ci:check was not run. It follows the template's Description, Related Issues, Testing, and Screenshots headings. The Screenshots section is addressed by explaining that no screenshot was attached and why. The description is complete enough for review.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#924` has two coding requirements. Both are implemented at the reviewed head. 1. NVTX matches count in the search results display [`#924`]. In `ResourceTimelinesTree.tsx`, `useResourceTimelinesTreeModel` accepts `siblingFilterMatchCount` (default `0`). `ResourceFilterSearch` receives `matchCount={resourceFilterResult.matchCount + siblingFilterMatchCount}`. In `QueryResourceTree.tsx`, the value passed is `nvtxTree.filterMatchCount`. The shared counter therefore includes NVTX matches. Each tree keeps its own match count. 2. Resource type and FSM type filters return no NVTX rows [`#924`]. In `NvtxTree.tsx`, `useNvtxTreeModel` returns an empty result (`directMatchIds` empty, `filteredTree` null, `matchCount` 0, `isActive` true) when `resourceFilter.resourceTypes` or `resourceFilter.fsmTypes` is non-empty. The memo dependencies include both type filters, so the result updates when they change. Without type filters, the search path (`filterNvtxTree`) is unchanged. The PR adds regression tests in `QueryResourceTree.test.tsx` for NVTX-only and mixed counts, and for exclusion under both type filters. The PR reports that these tests fail on `main`. I did not run the tests. The count and filter behavior rely on the diff and the PR report. I did not confirm that `filterMatchCount` already exists on the NVTX model at the merge base. The diff shows no change that adds it, so it must already exist for the code to compile.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR diff (merge base `aed8628` to head `70c785d`) changes four files, all in `ui/src/components/timeline-tree/`: - `NvtxTree.tsx`: type-filter exclusion for NVTX rows (`#924` requirement 2). - `ResourceTimelinesTree.tsx`: new optional `siblingFilterMatchCount` prop and its addition to the displayed match count (`#924` requirement 1). - `QueryResourceTree.tsx`: passes `nvtxTree.filterMatchCount` into the resource tree model (`#924` requirement 1). - `QueryResourceTree.test.tsx`: regression tests for both requirements, as described in the PR. Each change connects to an objective in `#924`. The test file supports the changes. No unrelated refactoring, feature, or configuration change appears in the reviewed diffs. The PR description states that the existing Show All behavior is unchanged. The NVTX search path without type filters still calls `filterNvtxTree` with the same arguments, which supports that statement.
